RAG System Features and Capabilities

## Multimodal Support
The system supports various document types:
- Text documents (PDF, TXT, DOCX)
- Images (JPG, PNG, GIF)
- Audio files (MP3, WAV)
- Video files (MP4, AVI)

## Query Types
Users can ask different types of questions:
- Lookup queries: "What is the file size limit?"
- Reasoning queries: "Why does the system use knowledge graphs?"
- Semantic linkage: "How are entities related in my documents?"

## Processing Pipeline
1. Document upload and validation
2. Content extraction
3. Chunking and embedding generation
4. Vector storage in Qdrant
5. Entity extraction
6. Knowledge graph construction in Neo4j

## Evaluation Metrics
The system tracks:
- Retrieval quality scores
- Response latency
- Hallucination control
- Answer relevancy
- Faithfulness to source material
- Contextual relevancy
